title: Pass the batch's abort signal into the BYOK extraction call, so a stopped batch skips the re-send and aborts the fetch
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/byok-upload.ts extractDirect takes no signal and re-sends once on bad JSON (:84-88); callAnthropicDirectRaw's fetch (byok-anthropic.ts:67-76) has no signal. So after a Cancel (US-12 AC5a) or the deadline (AC5b) each of the up to 2 calls in flight finishes and may make one more paid call. Passing the signal would skip the second send and abort the fetch. Unknown whether aborting an already-sent fetch avoids the charge. Found in PR 1769 review R1
